title: Rav Sama son of Rav Yirmeyah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Ketubot 33a; Hyman infers from the passage that he lived in Abaye’s time.[^1]

notes.text: The saved Davidson Ketubot33a scalar explicitly has Rav Sama son of Rav Yirmeyah raising an objection. Lived in Abaye’s time remains Hyman’s inference, with its inferential force intact; the selected scalar alone does not prove the chronology. Abaye gains no title.
